title: Default VAPID subject Apple accepts, push failures logged, Phone push line in Health
goal: Web Push reaches Apple devices, and a failed send is visible instead of swallowed
acceptance: A committed test fails first: the VAPID header's sub is a valid https or mailto with a real domain by default; a failed dispatch is logged and stored
Default subject https://github.com/voidbrain/nerv, configurable with config push.subject (https URL or mailto with a dotted domain, not .local or localhost)
A failed send logs the endpoint host, status and the push service's reason, never the full endpoint or keys; 404/410 still delete the subscription
Health shows a read-only Phone push line: subscribed devices, last delivery result (ok or failed with reason) and time
docs/acceptance/f004-t06-phone-push-procedure.md uses a working nerv remind command
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, endpoints or personal data in Git.
validation: Every test reading live.js, dashboard.js or web/src
escalation: Never log a full push endpoint or key

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: subject default and validation, failure logging and stored result, one Health line. Not a measurement.
